name: rpstills portrait cheek trial v0
status: TRIAL. Not a house standard: the house skin reference is undecided. This file exists to exercise rpstills develop; do not deliver against it.
space: Developed RAW to sRGB (16-bit TIFF). The solve measures CIELAB (D65) on the sRGB render.
notes: Target: mean CIELAB over the cheek apples (rpstills.skin.cheek_mask) of L* 64, a* 15, b* 14; hue 43 degrees, Rec.709 vectorscope 117.7 degrees. It was picked by eye on one overcast portrait session and is a trial value.

The published skin-tone line on a Rec.709 vectorscope sits near 123 degrees; this target reads about 5.5 degrees redder. Which reference rules is undecided, and rpstills audit reports the distance to both.

tint_max 6 keeps white fabric from picking up a visible green or magenta cast. It was set in LightCraft tint units; Apple's tint scale differs, so on the apple backend it is a bound, not a calibrated limit.
develop.values is empty: the apple backend takes only exposure, temperature and tint. A LightCraft look puts LightCraft control ids there and a LightCraft profile id in develop.profile.
